title: Los Alamos insider: their propulsion systems are grown

tellings.quote: Well, I had one guy just say, "Well, I can Their propulsion systems are not built. They're grown."

plain: Someone at Los Alamos, the New Mexico weapons laboratory, is said to have claimed that the engines of alien craft "are not built. They're grown." Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted by aliens, tells Michels that one man he spoke to said this, and he does not name the man. If true, it would mean the craft are made more like living things than machines.
